history.summary: Famous Swayambhu (self-manifested) Hanumanji temple at Lambhvel village on the Anand-Nadiad highway (Dandi Road), ~2 km from Anand city; CSV town corrected from Anand to Lambhvel. A travel blog claims the temple is more than 500 years old — UNVERIFIED; the present structure has been renovated and rebuilt in white marble, and the campus includes a large marriage hall. It is a major centre of faith in and around Anand, drawing thousands of devotees especially on Saturdays and Tuesdays, and hosts a huge fair on Kali Chaudas.

name: Lambhvel Hanumanji Temple
town_description: Lambhvel is a village in Anand taluka, about 2 km from Anand city on the Anand-Nadiad (Dandi) road. It is known chiefly for its Swayambhu Hanumanji temple and the large Kali Chaudas fair it hosts each year. The surrounding Charotar region of Anand and Kheda districts is known for prosperous farming and many temples.
